sol.label: Edit profile
sol.detail: The profile menu shows Default with a checkmark immediately below the selector. The sidebar keeps the connected mouse and 50% battery visible.

sol.label: Outside the diagram
sol.detail: Hovering marker 2 outlines Back button and shows its label. MX Master 4 adds Haptic Sense Panel. The separate Button 0x01FF row becomes Spare button after naming.

sol.label: Show diagram
sol.detail: Compact list rows label Edit and show shortcut keycaps next to Close tab and Task View.

sol.label: Select an action
sol.detail: The thumb crop pins marker 2 behind the wheel. Selecting Copy adds Draft to the row and enables Save action.

sol.label: No matching actions
sol.detail: A Copy search shows Edit, Ctrl and C keycaps, and Select. An empty search offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.

sol.label: Switch pointer speed
sol.detail: Both speeds have numeric fields and sliders, with Current and Next press values below. The short dialog fits both sliders side by side.

sol.label: Keyboard shortcut
sol.detail: Press a key shows Esc guidance. M survives the tab switch and the short layout, and reopening the saved K shows Assigned now and Saved.

sol.label: SmartShift flick sensitivity
sol.detail: SmartShift has a filled radio and amber border. Always ratchet leaves the saved level visible and explains how to adjust it.

sol.label: Saved swipe distance
sol.detail: Swipes use directional arrows and right-aligned action chips. Turning gestures off keeps the five mappings editable and shows the saved 60 counts.

sol.label: Pick a window
sol.detail: Window capture shows a 6s badge and an Add 6 seconds button. After capture, brave.exe appears in Preview app alongside a matching confirmation.

sol.label: Edit button mappings
sol.detail: Disconnected and No device each explain what can still be edited. The connected view separates Bluetooth, firmware, battery, and DPI.

sol.label: HID++ features
sol.detail: Feature names and monospaced IDs stay paired in two columns. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs remain above the list at compact width.

sol.label: Remapping paused
sol.detail: Resume failed keeps Retry in the title bar and spells out the tray steps in a numbered card. After retry, a green Remapping resumed badge replaces the red paused state. The compact editor puts Applies after resume beside Save shortcut.

sol.label: Start with Windows
sol.detail: The native menu swaps Pause remapping for Resume remapping. A checkmark shows startup is enabled, and horizontal separators group the commands.

terra.label: Buttons
terra.detail: The left navigation highlights Buttons and the Edit profile menu lists Default and Preview app.

terra.label: Outside the diagram
terra.detail: Numbered markers connect mouse artwork to assignment cards, with a separate reported button below.

terra.label: Button list
terra.detail: Compact rows show button names, shortcut keycaps, and Edit controls.

terra.label: Select an action
terra.detail: The Back button editor pairs a thumb-button image with categories and action rows.

terra.label: No matching actions
terra.detail: An empty search offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.

terra.label: Wheel mode button
terra.detail: Mouse actions include a ratchet toggle and a two-speed DPI editor showing current and next values.

terra.label: Keyboard shortcut
terra.detail: Recording changes the panel to Press a key, then shows the new key and an enabled save button.

terra.label: Scroll
terra.detail: Wheel mode cards, toggles, and sliders show selected states and numeric values.

terra.label: Gestures
terra.detail: Five directional rows pair arrows with assigned actions and shortcut keycaps.

terra.label: Profiles
terra.detail: Numbered profile cards show app executable chips and move controls; the window picker displays a countdown.

terra.label: Device
terra.detail: Connection, firmware, battery, and pointer speed appear in separate cards; disconnected states offer button mapping.

terra.label: HID++ features
terra.detail: Feature names and hexadecimal IDs appear in two columns, with copy buttons above.

terra.label: Remapping paused
terra.detail: A status chip offers Resume, while conflict and save errors explain recovery steps.

terra.label: Open mouse settings
terra.detail: The native tray menu changes Pause remapping to Resume remapping and checks Start with Windows.

astra.label: Edit profile
astra.detail: The checked Default menu item and amber Buttons navigation state remain distinct in both themes.

astra.label: Outside the diagram
astra.detail: Numbered markers match the mapping cards. Hovering Back button highlights marker 2 and its card; the extra control can become Spare button.

astra.label: Show diagram
astra.detail: Compact list rows keep the action names, keycaps and labeled Edit buttons visible. Compact diagram rows retain the button numbers.

astra.label: Select an action
astra.detail: The editor pairs a close mouse detail with categories, shortcuts, a selected checkmark and an explicit Draft label.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: The empty result offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut. A Copy result shows Ctrl and C keycaps beside Select.

astra.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
astra.detail: Both DPI values have numeric inputs and sliders, with Current: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI below.

astra.label: Press a key
astra.detail: Recording changes the card to an amber outline and Stop recording. Saved K reopens with Recorded key, Done and a green Saved status.

astra.label: SmartShift flick sensitivity
astra.detail: The three wheel mode cards use radio circles and an amber selected border. Disabled sliders explain which setting enables them.

astra.label: Minimum swipe distance
astra.detail: Directional arrows distinguish the five action rows. The distance control translates 60 counts into about 1.5 mm.

astra.label: Pick a window
astra.detail: The capture state shows a 6s timer with Add 6 seconds and Cancel. Long profile names wrap cleanly beside Up, Down and Delete.

astra.label: Reported mouse features
astra.detail: Bluetooth, firmware and the 50% battery bar form clear cards. Disconnected and No device states offer Edit button mappings.

astra.label: HID++ features
astra.detail: Named features appear in two columns with monospaced hexadecimal IDs. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs sit above the data.

astra.label: Remapping paused
astra.detail: The title bar distinguishes paused and resumed states. Save failure says Copy is still unsaved and provides Try again and Back to editing.

astra.label: Resume remapping
astra.detail: The menu switches Pause remapping to Resume remapping and retains a check beside Start with Windows. Separators isolate settings and quit.
